Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent encountered conflicting birth dates from credible sources (Britannica and Biography.com). The WebSurfer should have prioritized cross-referencing additional credible sources beyond Britannica, which had loading issues and discrepancies, to ensure the correct birth date was verified.
